data.title: 爱蜜莉雅 · 艾利欧尔雪林
data.description: 艾利欧尔雪林里，爱蜜莉雅换上淡紫羊毛旅行斗篷、象牙白麻花针织长上衣与保暖打底裤，帽兜放下，尖耳和白花发饰仍清楚可见。她停在被雪覆盖的窄径上，双手戴着浅色连指手套，轻握斗篷领口回眸。近处低垂的结冰枝条掠过画面下缘，树根旁积雪留着一小串脚印；中层裸树干沿小径错落排开，远处雪林因空气透视变得浅蓝。右后方冬日阳光穿过树干，勾亮银发、斗篷外缘和冰棱，雪面反光柔和照亮脸颊与衣襟；树影斜跨小径——「虽然大家总因为我的容貌而害怕我……但昴却总是毫无偏见地看着我。真的很谢谢你，昴。」
data.location: 艾利欧尔雪林窄径，近处冰枝与树根，中层树干通向浅蓝远林
data.action: 在雪径上停步回眸，戴手套的双手轻握斗篷领口，帽兜放下露出尖耳和发饰。
data.lighting: winter sun from the back right through bare trunks; snow-reflected fill on face and tunic
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, environmental portrait with low icy branches and receding snow path
data.promptProse: Low ice-coated branches cross the lower edge of the view into Elior Forest. Emilia has paused on the snowy path and turns back, her mittened hands lightly holding the collar of a lilac wool cloak. Its lowered hood reveals her pointed ears and white flower clip above an ivory knitted tunic and dark thermal leggings. A short trail of footprints passes snow-covered roots beside her. Bare trunks overlap at varied distances along the narrow path, opening into a pale blue forest softened by winter air. Use an eye-level cowboy view with enough space around her to follow these layers. Winter sun enters from the back right between trunks, outlining silver hair, cloak fibers and faceted icicles. Snow-reflected light softly lifts her cheek and tunic front; long tree shadows cross the path without hiding the footprints.
